◆ SNEPPX_tensor_fake_quant()

SNEPPXTensor * SNEPPX_tensor_fake_quant ( const SNEPPXTensor *  src,
float  scale,
int  bits 
)

Perform Tensor Fake Quant (symmetric affine, straight-through).

Quantizes src to bits using scale (symmetric, zero point = 0), then de-quantizes back to float. Used for quantization-aware training: the forward is the (non-differentiable-looking) quantize/dequantize, while the backward is the straight-through estimator (identity) handled by the autodiff op SNEPPX_fake_quant.

Parameters
src[in] Src value.
scale[in] Scale value (> 0).
bits[in] Bit width (2..16), e.g. 8 for INT8.
Returns
Pointer on success, NULL on error.
